API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIPrivate Service Edge Group ManagementGets the Service Edge Group details for the specified ID.
Gets the Service Edge Group details for the specified ID.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/serviceEdgeGroup/:serviceEdgeGroupId

Gets the Service Edge Group details for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

serviceEdgeGroupId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the Service Edge Group.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404
405
409
415
500
503

OK
